trajectory_messages.content:
I'm seeing a bug where the fullscreen button on several visual components doesn't actually work when clicked.

*   When the fullscreen button is configured to appear in the AnnotatedImage component and a value is set, clicking the button labeled 'Fullscreen' must cause the button labeled 'Exit fullscreen mode' to become visible (and 'Fullscreen' to disappear), and clicking 'Exit fullscreen mode' must restore the 'Fullscreen' button.

*   When the fullscreen button is configured in the Image component running in interactive mode with a value set, clicking 'Fullscreen' must toggle to display 'Exit fullscreen mode', and clicking 'Exit fullscreen mode' must toggle back to display 'Fullscreen'.

*   When the fullscreen button is configured in the ImageSlider component and preview images are present, clicking 'Fullscreen' must toggle to display 'Exit fullscreen mode', and clicking 'Exit fullscreen mode' must toggle back to display 'Fullscreen'.

*   When the fullscreen button is configured in the NativePlot component, clicking 'Fullscreen' must toggle to display 'Exit fullscreen mode', and clicking 'Exit fullscreen mode' must toggle back to display 'Fullscreen'. The chart must continue to render properly after toggling.

*   The fullscreen state must be tracked locally within each component so that the button label updates reactively: 'Fullscreen' when not in fullscreen mode and 'Exit fullscreen mode' when in fullscreen mode. These aria-label strings must be used exactly as specified.


**CRITICAL:** Do not modify any files in the `tests/` directory.
The verification system will apply test patches automatically.
Your task is to implement the feature in source files only.
I'll start by exploring the codebase to understand the structure and find the relevant components.

The `git diff --stat` error is from an unrelated submodule ref (`.claude/skills`); my four source files are all modified as intended.

## Summary

The root cause was a **Svelte 5 migration mismatch**. `js/atoms/src/FullscreenButton.svelte` was migrated to expose an `onclick(fullscreen: boolean)` callback prop, but four consumer components still wired it via the old Svelte 4 `on:fullscreen` event dispatch — which the button no longer emits. So clicks did nothing. (Gallery, plot, dataframe, and static ImagePreview had already been migrated correctly, which is why only "several" components broke.)

Fixes — each now updates local fullscreen state through `onclick`:

1. **`js/annotatedimage/Index.svelte`** (AnnotatedImage) — Svelte 5, sets local `$state` `fullscreen` directly.
2. **`js/nativeplot/Index.svelte`** (NativePlot) — Svelte 5, sets local `$state` `fullscreen` directly; chart re-renders reactively as before.
3. **`js/image/shared/ImageUploader.svelte`** (Image, interactive mode) — Svelte 4; sets local `fullscreen` and re-`dispatch`es `fullscreen` to its parent (`Image/Index.svelte`), mirroring the already-correct `ImagePreview.svelte`. Added `fullscreen: boolean` to its event-dispatcher type.
4. **`js/imageslider/shared/SliderPreview.svelte`** (ImageSlider) — Svelte 4; same pattern, and added `fullscreen: boolean` to its dispatcher type.

The button label now toggles reactively — `"Fullscreen"` ⇄ `"Exit fullscreen mode"` — since the `FullscreenButton` renders its label off the `fullscreen` prop, which each component keeps in sync locally. The exact aria-label strings come unchanged from the atom (`"Fullscreen"` / `"Exit fullscreen mode"`). I left the `tests/` directory untouched.
